prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity landscape 16:9 gameplay screen composition study for the original pixel art browser game Alchemist's Descent, approved direction The Living Descent. This is a 2D side-view interactive platforming GAME SCREEN, absolutely not a website or marketing poster: the entire 16:9 image is the playable cave viewport. Consistent coarse handcrafted pixel grid, as if 575 by 324 logical pixels enlarged without smoothing; every creature and terrain detail uses that grid, restrained 24-color palette of wet slate blue black, mineral chalk, oxidized copper, small bioluminescent amber and mint light. Terrain solid clean silhouettes, varied large masonry and natural stone clusters, clear traversable negative space. Depth: dark foreground occluding corners, strongly readable gameplay middle plane, huge quiet faded machinery in background. Small warm ivory robed alchemist roughly 16 logical pixels tall with copper wand, bright enough to locate immediately. Sparse legible semantic UI only: top left a modest health arc beside label '110', active wand icon and 3 small reagent slots bottom left, a compact objective upper right. No marketing text, no web nav, no cards or gradients, no frame around game, no kill counter. Compositional structure and actual playable routes are the main subject. Rendering goal expensive-looking hand-authored pixel world that can become real grid geometry, procedural articulated creatures and background assets. A tiny contextual interaction text may appear near an object. The intention is a distinct original corroded alchemical refinery with a living ecosystem inspired by the systemic physics of Noita and organic animal behavior of Rain World; no copied characters or logos. Composition B: 'The Sluice'. Main playable route descends in a diagonal from upper-left broken pipe walkway, via center island carrying small alchemist and a physical brass valve, to lower-right dry arch. A coherent reservoir of teal water fills lower-left only, a long cream-and-slate segmented eel turning underwater, water spilling through a small destructible sluice into the lower channel. Use crystal-clear air/water/solid distinction. Three huge background refinery columns and distant circular boilers extend upward behind the active plane without noisy detail. Insects above center island; a Weaver with naturally articulated planted limbs stalks right ceiling. Warm amber valve lamp versus cool water reflection. Interface text upper right 'Open a dry route' and small 'E · Turn valve' beside player. Three routes should read: valve diversion, upper stealth ledge, lower water. No particle soup.
approval: User approved the Living Descent proposal and delegated creative implementation; these studies instantiate its three authored encounter spaces.
notLiteral: UI text and mechanics are implemented in semantic code and the simulation; generated geometry is an art reference, not collision authority.
